spanish: Y trajo el arca al tabernáculo, y puso el velo de la cortina, y cubrió sobre el arca del testimonio, conforme a lo que mandó Jehová a Moisés.
grammarChanges: 'mishkán' -> 'tabernáculo' (h02040021005, H4908, definite common noun): translated instead of transliterated, per cited fail.
'parójet' -> 'velo' (h02040021008, H6532, construct common noun): translated instead of transliterated; article changed from feminine 'la' to masculine 'el' to agree with 'velo'.
'masaj' -> 'cortina' (h02040021009, H4539, definite common noun): translated instead of transliterated; the governing 'del' became 'de la' to agree with the feminine noun 'cortina'.
